outcome: relationship between station and dilation during the first stage of labor
cohort: Nulliparous and multiparous women with singleton cephalic presentations at ≥37 weeks' gestation with electronic fetal monitoring tracings, who delivered vaginally without instrumentation and had 5-minute Apgar scores >6
finding: There is a linear relationship between station and dilation during the first stage of labor in women who delivered vaginally without instrumentation, with a 5th-95th range of station at any given dilation spanning about 3-4 cm.
